title: Try Again Only When It Helps

args: let n = 0; return await retryIf(async () => { if (++n < 3) throw new Error("busy"); return n; }, 5, () => true);
let n = 0; await retryIf(async () => { n++; throw new Error("bad input"); }, 5, () => false).catch(() => {}); return n;
return await retryIf(async () => { throw new Error("bad input"); }, 5, () => false).catch((e) => e.message);
let n = 0; return await retryIf(async () => { throw new Error("down " + ++n); }, 3, () => true).catch((e) => [n, e.message]);
let n = 0; return await retryIf(async () => { throw ++n; }, 5, (e) => e < 2).catch((e) => "stopped at " + e);
